rationale: dual_domain_supervised-claude-agentic: unet_c=16, epochs=44, batch_size=1, lr=0.001, optimizer=adam, lambda_neg=0.03, grad_clip=1.0, train_n=400, val_n=200, val_chunk=10, seed=49, rationale=iter-20 (FINAL) dual_domain_supervised, re-split Breast-CT val=200. SIX-BOX at BEST config (c16/ep44/lr1e-3/lneg0.03/bs1/tn400). (1) PRIOR: 7 seed replicates -- 42=0.8915,43=0.8589,44=0.8317,45=0.8866,46=0.8844,47=0.7672,48=0.8925 -> mean~0.862 sstd~0.043, spread 0.125. Seed variance is the DOMINANT effect; the seed-42 0.8915 that led the earlier sweep is an upper-tail draw (5 of 7 seeds cluster 0.86-0.89, one low outlier 0.767). (2) Failure mode: the single-seed(=42) knob sweep (iters1-13) was noise-confounded -- lr/lambda_neg deltas (~0.005-0.02) sit inside this +-0.04 seed band, so most are not statistically distinguishable from noise; epochs (10->44, +0.08) and the initial onboarding (clearing FBP) are the only effects clearly ABOVE the noise floor. (3) ONE KNOB: seed 49 (final 8th replicate). (4) HYPOTHESIS: n=8 gives the honest reportable config number ~0.86+-0.04, closing the run; the primary finding is the mean+-std characterization, not the 0.8915 peak. (5) BUDGET: ~941s, inside 20-min. (6) FINAL iter of the 20-iter search. Artifacts saved.
